params.ci_meaning: Wilson 95% interval of the slice's direct observations; accompanies solution_rate. Inferred slices keep the direct CI while the point estimate is pooled.

params.quality_judge: kimi (kimi-code/kimi-for-coding), rubric v1; per-cell median of trial quality_mean (1-5 scale); null when no trials were judged (infra failures, pending hard band). Stack rows carry the n-weighted median of per-task quality_means.

Read from meta.json, falling back to the score_overlay.json sidecar an offline re-score writes beside it. Optional and additive: ungraded trials contribute nothing (never zero), so score_n counts the graded trials behind score_mean / score_median. Cell score_median is the median of its graded trials; stack score_median is the n-weighted median of per-task medians and score_mean the mean over all graded trials. score_tiers counts bronze/silver/gold/none, and score_by_tier sums earned/weight per tier.
